display.purpose: Landing page hero only. text-4xl to text-6xl responsive. Never appears in-app.

title.purpose: Page titles, panel headers, greeting text. One per visible viewport.

heading.purpose: Card titles, session names, route info primary values, building names.

body.purpose: Chat messages, descriptions, button labels. 14px base for information-dense UI.

body-sm.purpose: Timestamps, secondary info, tool badge content, sidebar session previews.

caption.purpose: Labels, metadata, navigation group headers, tool call summaries.

mono.purpose: Course codes, times, building codes, inline code, tool parameters, dollar amounts.

shadows.name: neu-surface-shadow
shadows.purpose: Shared raised material for controls, contained cards, wider-screen panels, and overlays. Mobile page frames and primary workspace regions stay flat.

shadows.name: neu-inset-shadow
shadows.purpose: Sidebar, composer, recessed wells. Whisper-level recess.

motion.name: overlay-presence
motion.purpose: Shared popover/dialog opacity and small anchored movement. Closing controls become inactive immediately; interrupted motion continues from its current style. Reduced-motion removal follows parent layout registration.

motion.name: inline-disclosure
motion.purpose: Conditional filters, course destinations, show-more lists, and common free time without losing caller-owned values.

motion.name: mode-indicator
motion.purpose: Connects a phone mode selection to its destination without delaying navigation.

motion.name: content-arrival
motion.purpose: New results and visible views. Never replay on streaming updates or retain invalidated data.

motion.name: notice-arrival
motion.purpose: Bounded feedback and notification arrivals; notifications remain above phone navigation.

motion.name: chart-arrival
motion.purpose: Grade bars reveal while numeric data and axes update immediately.

motion.name: neu-ease
motion.purpose: Panel animations, collapse/expand, menu entrance. Settling-into-place feel.

motion.name: details-open
motion.purpose: Native details expansion and collapse where supported. The pseudo-element transition is disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: spring-hero
motion.purpose: Landing page hero and CTA entrances. Spring physics, not CSS.

narrative.overview:
Use restrained depth for controls, contained cards, and overlays. Keep mobile pages flat and edge-to-edge so students can use the available screen for their task. Raised actions, recessed inputs, and flat content share one neutral material. Use the smallest shadow that communicates a boundary.

Use small offsets (2-3px), soft blur (4-8px), and low opacity (4-6%) for composed shadows. Keep the light source at the upper left and use the same recipes across related controls.

Choose spacing, type, and radii from the documented scales. Keep app transitions brief and tied to interaction. Reserve larger type, spring entrances, and blur reveals for the landing page.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained depth for controls and contained surfaces; flat mobile pages
Precision and consistency as the aesthetic itself
Muted indigo accent, used sparingly, always meaning interactive
Content-forward: neumorphic frame never competes with chat or map data
Landing page permitted to be expressive; in-app is disciplined

rules.name: Concentric contours
rules.body: For close matching corners, subtract the measured border-box inset from the outer radius. Expanded navigation uses 16/8/8, compact navigation and theme groups 12/4/8, segments 8/4/4, timetable layers 12/2/10 then 10/2/8, and single-line composer actions 16/6/10 on phones or 16/10/6 on wider screens (outer/inset/inner). Independent cards, fields, avatars and interior rows keep their own geometry.

rules.name: Optical anchors
rules.body: Center workspace leading controls on a 28px title anchor without shrinking targets. Align plain panel content and discovery searches to the header's 16px inset. Keep dense list exceptions explicit. Phone menu effects use 8px edge and title clearance. Bottom-tab feedback paints 8px inside contiguous 60px-high hit regions; the marker sits 4px below the content top. Prerequisite view labels use equal grid columns and no wrapping, with an 8px controls/result gap and no empty feedback spacer. Theme groups stay intrinsic-width and non-shrinking at 144px phone or 108px wider-screen; narrow account rows wrap with an 8px row gap. Verify original-scale images alongside measured bounds, not class names alone.

rules.name: The Muted-for-AA Rule
rules.body: All subdued text uses --muted (#5a6066). Never --outline or --outline-variant for text — they fail WCAG AA on light surfaces.

rules.name: The Indigo Scarcity Rule
rules.body: The primary indigo appears only on interactive elements and active states. Never for decorative purposes, background fills, or large surfaces. Its presence always means actionable or current.

rules.name: The Opacity Layering Rule
rules.body: Use fractional opacity modifiers (/15, /40, /60) to create tinted surfaces that remain translucent. Solid token colors for text and borders; opacity modifiers for background tints and state indicators.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Bold Rule
rules.body: Emphasis uses weight 500–550. Bold (700+) never appears. Maximum weight is 600 for markdown strong, table headers, and list markers.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Data Rule
rules.body: Structured identifiers (course codes, times, building codes, distances, amounts) render in Commit Mono. Data has a different texture than prose.

rules.name: The 14px-Base Rule
rules.body: Body text is 0.875rem (14px). This is an information-dense tool, not a reading experience. Tighter base allows more content visible without scrolling.

rules.name: The Landing Exception Rule
rules.body: The landing page uses text-4xl through text-6xl, custom line-heights (1.05), tighter tracking (-0.035em), and spring physics. These values are exclusive to the marketing surface.

rules.name: The Dual-Tier Rule
rules.body: Tier 1 (Tailwind shadow-* utilities) for one-off depth. Tier 2 (.neu-* classes) for composed surfaces. Never mix on the same element.

rules.name: The Light-Source Rule
rules.body: Light source is always upper-left. Every shadow falls bottom-right, every highlight top-left. Consistent across both tiers.

rules.name: The Whisper-Dimension Rule
rules.body: Use minimal resting depth on controls, contained cards, desktop panels, and overlays. Mobile page frames and primary workspace regions stay flat. Hover and active states expand or invert the control shadow to --neu-inset-shadow.

dos: Do apply .neu-panel / .neu-raised / .neu-inset for composed surfaces — they carry the unified shadow recipe.
Do use --muted (#5a6066) for all subdued text. Never --outline or --outline-variant for text.
Do use --neu-ease (cubic-bezier 0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for all in-app layout animations at 150-350ms.
Do respect reduced motion for both entry and exit, including native details and synchronous modal removal. Keep state changes immediate and legible.
Do use [data-theme="dark"] for theme switching — never prefers-color-scheme media query.
Do keep mobile pages and their primary workspace regions flat and edge-to-edge. Use resting depth on controls, contained cards, desktop panels, and overlays.
Do derive close inset corner radii from measured edges and preserve independent card geometry.
Do distinguish the 48px collapsed rail from its 60px reserved offset, center its controls, contain keyboard focus paint, and match its boot geometry.
Do use one compact session-action menu, retain touch/no-hover access, preserve drafts and errors, and commit local mutations after server success.
Do use asymmetric bubble radii to indicate message direction.
Do use opacity modifiers on color tokens for tinted backgrounds.
Do enforce 44px action targets, 48px drawer rows, and 60px bottom mode targets on phones.
Do render phone menu controls inside route headers and keep shell navigation available during loading.
Do use env(safe-area-inset-bottom) for bottom-pinned elements.
donts: Don't mix Tier 1 (shadow-* utilities) and Tier 2 (.neu-* classes) on the same element.
Don't add border to .neu-panel or .neu-raised elements. Exception: .neu-button has 1px border-subtle.
Don't use pure black in any shadow — warm gray in light mode, deep neutral in dark mode only.
Don't apply backdrop-filter outside .glass-neu. Glass is for overlays, never decorative.
Don't animate shadow values directly — animate transform and switch classes via state.
Don't apply neumorphic depth to text content — depth frames containers, content stays flat.
Don't use font-weight 700+ anywhere. Maximum is 600.
Don't use primary indigo for backgrounds, decoration, or large surfaces. It means interactive only.
Don't add decorative page-load choreography or animate browser-driven viewport sizing. Preserve existing task-driven springs and camera behavior.
Don't retain obsolete routes, groups, search results, or drop targets for an exit animation.
Don't wrap a phone's main view in a rounded card or restore shell gutters below 640px. Keep content and control padding inside the full-width page.
Don't add duplicate mode controls or bottom safe-area padding above the phone mode bar.
Don't create new shadow recipes. Use --neu-surface-shadow or --neu-inset-shadow, or the five Tier 1 utilities.
